brand.name: Agentic Keyboard
control.focusOnSelect: Bring Kiro Crew to the front when K1–K3 picks a chat
control.voiceTarget.send: Confirm on the keyboard, then send (default)
control.voiceTarget.inject: Type into the Crew input box
control.voiceTarget.sendHint: The words stay on the keyboard screen. K4 deletes, hold the voice key to say it again, K1 cancels, K6 sends them to the chat picked with K1–K3. The Crew window does not need to be in front.
control.voiceTarget.injectHint: The words are typed into the Kiro Crew input box as you speak; K6 presses Enter. The Crew window must be open.
keymap.title: Key mapping
keymap.voiceHold: Hold to talk — press and hold to record, release to stop. No gestures to set.
keymap.tapHint: Tap a key below to change what it does.
keymap.resolved.modelMenu: {gesture} → open the model / mode menu on the screen
keymap.resolved.modelToggle: {gesture} → switch between Auto and your last model
pending.title: Awaiting confirmation
pending.k4: K4: click = delete char · long = delete all
help.keymap.panel: Each key plays a role; the role decides what it does in each board state and which LED it lights. Pick a role here; the firmware applies the rest.
help.keymap.instance: Double-clicking a Chat key switches the Crew instance via Ctrl+N — Local, then your remote crews in order.
help.led: The dot on each key mirrors the keyboard's real light: color = state (green idle, red busy, orange waiting, blue info), blink = the gesture.
conn.pairing.title: Pairing window
conn.pairing.how: Open it on the keyboard: hold the knob → Settings → Pairing mode → K6.
conn.pairing.reason.closed: Open the pairing window on the keyboard first.
conn.pairing.reason.exists: A License is already stored. Press K6 on the keyboard's Settings → Credentials to allow one overwrite.
conn.pairing.reason.confirm_on_device: Confirm the reset with K6 on the keyboard (K4 cancels).
conn.pairing.reason.cancelled: The reset was cancelled on the keyboard.
conn.pairing.reason.busy: A reset is already waiting for confirmation on the keyboard.
conn.pairing.reason.other: The keyboard did not accept the command.
conn.cred.title: Credentials
conn.ble.title: Bluetooth pairing
conn.ble.how: Connect over USB and open the pairing window on the keyboard to pair.
conn.voice.title: Voice mode
conn.voice.empty: Hold K5 on the keyboard to talk to the Tuya agent.
conn.error.windowClosed: Open the pairing window on the keyboard first: hold the knob → Settings → Pairing mode → K6.
conn.error.exists: A License is already stored. To replace it, press K6 on the keyboard's Settings → Credentials first (valid once, for 60 s).
conn.error.cancelled: The reset was cancelled on the keyboard.
conn.pairing.confirmOnDevice: Confirm with K6 on the keyboard (K4 cancels).
help.conn.pairing: Wi-Fi, License and network reset are accepted only while this window is open, and only over USB. The keyboard opens it for 180 s after you confirm on the device, and closes it 5 s after the cloud connects.
help.conn.cred: Shows only whether a License is stored. The keyboard's Settings → Credentials shows Product ID, UUID and AuthKey as SET / NOT SET; the values are never sent to the Companion.
help.conn.ble: Bluetooth traffic is encrypted and authenticated with a key made on the keyboard. Pairing hands that key to this PC over USB only. Without it the keyboard ignores this PC over Bluetooth and sends it nothing. Pairing again replaces the key; clear it on the keyboard with Settings → Credentials, K1 twice.
help.conn.voice: Switch on the keyboard only (Settings → Voice mode). ASR types what you say into Kiro Crew. Chat talks to the Tuya agent: replies are spoken, shown on the keyboard and here, and never sent to Kiro Crew.
ota.title: Firmware update (USB)
ota.package: File: {version} · {profile} build · signed with the {key} key · {size} KB
ota.state.waiting_confirm: Press K6 on the keyboard to install {version} (K1 cancels)
ota.state.sending: Sending {percent}% — keep the USB cable in
ota.state.failed: Update failed: {reason}. The keyboard keeps its current firmware.
ota.hint: USB connection required; updates never go over Bluetooth. Only signed .akota files are accepted, and only newer versions. Settings, keymap, pairing and License are kept.
